title: Herby, Hearty, Horseradish Welsh Beef Sunday Roast
description: A classic Welsh Sunday roast featuring tender beef, creamy mashed potatoes, and a hint of spicy horseradish. Perfect for a special occasion or family gathering.
instructions: In a large wok, melt 60g of the butter over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots to the wok and continue cooking for another 5 minutes.
Add the chopped potatoes to the wok and cook for a further 5 minutes.
Season the beef brisket with salt, pepper, and chopped thyme. Place the beef in the wok and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the wok to the preheated oven and roast the beef for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
While the beef is cooking, prepare the horseradish sauce by mixing the grated horseradish with 120g of the remaining butter and 2 cloves of minced garlic.
Remove the beef from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the sliced beef with the roasted vegetables, mashed potatoes, and a dollop of horseradish sauce on top.
